parameters.content:
## W22 Alerts (devops-security)
Threshold table, sources and the ops.notifications contract: `automation/W22.md`.

Triggers: 5-min threshold sweep (+ re-queue of console approvals stuck in 'sending' > 10 min, max 3, I-36b), 5-min escalation/DND release, hourly Flow ping + uptime + WABA health, daily DKIM/DMARC, signals from other workflows (Execute Workflow), uptime-monitor callback, n8n Error Trigger.

Rules: dedupe same signal <= 1 per 24 h (SQL on dedupe_key); DND 22:00-07:00 SAST except guardrail trip, WABA restriction, payment failure, VPS/api down; unacked red at 2 h -> other partner; 4 h -> Twilio voice to both (the only voice use).

No secrets in this file. Credentials are referenced by name. Config from env (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, see SECURITY.md).

parameters.query:
WITH prior AS (
  SELECT id FROM ops.notifications
  WHERE dedupe_key = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status <> 'send_failed'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
), touched AS (
  UPDATE ops.notifications n SET last_seen_at = now(), seen_count = n.seen_count + 1
  FROM prior WHERE n.id = prior.id RETURNING n.id
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO ops.notifications (kind, "to", dedupe_key, signal_key, scope, severity, always_send, status, source, what, impact, first_action, since_label, primary_partner, payload)
  SELECT 'alert', COALESCE(NULLIF($14, ''), 'jonathan,kg'), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5::boolean, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13::jsonb
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prior)
  RETURNING id, status, severity, what, impact, first_action, since_label, primary_partner, always_send, "to"
)
SELECT id::text AS notification_id, status, severity, what, impact, first_action, since_label, primary_partner, always_send, false AS suppressed, "to" FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT id::text, 'suppressed', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, true, NULL FROM touched;

nodes.name: Every 5 min - escalation and DND release

parameters.query:
SELECT id::text AS id, id::text AS notification_id, signal_key, dedupe_key, severity, always_send, status, escalation_level,
  first_sent_at, acked_at, what, impact, first_action, since_label, primary_partner, "to"
FROM ops.notifications
WHERE status = 'held_dnd'
   OR (severity = 'red' AND acked_at IS NULL AND status IN ('sent', 'escalated') AND escalation_level < 2
       AND first_sent_at <= now() - interval '2 hours')
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 50;

UPDATE ops.notifications SET
  channel_log = COALESCE(channel_log, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('at', now(), 'channel', $2::text, 'who', $3::text, 'level', $4::int, 'http', $5::int)),
  status = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'email' THEN status
                WHEN $5::int BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN CASE WHEN $4::int > 0 THEN 'escalated' ELSE 'sent' END
                WHEN status IN ('sent', 'escalated') THEN status ELSE 'send_failed' END,
  sent_at = CASE WHEN $5::int BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND $2::text <> 'email' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END,
  first_sent_at = CASE WHEN $5::int BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND $2::text <> 'email' THEN COALESCE(first_sent_at, now()) ELSE first_sent_at END,
  escalation_level = CASE WHEN $5::int BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN GREATEST(escalation_level, $4::int) ELSE escalation_level END
WHERE id::text = $1::text;

parameters.query:
-- I-36b: W32 console approvals claimed ('sending') but never acked/failed within 10 min (crashed run, n8n restart).
-- Re-queue each stuck row once per sweep (status 'queued', attempts + 1) so W32's 1-min poll claims it again; after 3 re-queues -> send_failed.
-- attempts live in payload.requeue_attempts until ops.notifications has an attempts column (needs_human, platform-architect).
WITH stuck AS (
  SELECT id, COALESCE((payload->>'requeue_attempts')::int, 0) AS attempts
    FROM ops.notifications
   WHERE kind = 'approval' AND status = 'sending' AND updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
   ORDER BY updated_at
   FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
   LIMIT 50
), moved AS (
  UPDATE ops.notifications n
     SET status = CASE WHEN s.attempts < 3 THEN 'queued' ELSE 'send_failed' END,
         payload = COALESCE(n.payload, '{}'::jsonb)
                   || jsonb_build_object('requeue_attempts', LEAST(s.attempts + 1, 3),
                                         'requeue_note', CASE WHEN s.attempts < 3 THEN 'W22: stuck in sending > 10 min, re-queued'
                                                              ELSE 'W22: stuck in sending after 3 re-queues, gave up' END),
         updated_at = now()
    FROM stuck s
   WHERE n.id = s.id
  RETURNING n.id::text AS id, n.status, LEAST(s.attempts + 1, 3) AS attempts
)
SELECT id, status, attempts FROM moved ORDER BY id;
